newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli, German banks form trade finance venture.
newsitem.headline: Israeli, German banks form trade finance venture.

text.p: Israel's Poalim Capital Markets and Germany's Berliner Bank have formed a joint venture trade finance company for Israeli exporters, a Poalim spokesman said on Tuesday.
The company, PCM - International Trade Finance Ltd, will focus on Israeli export deals in South America, eastern Europe, Asia and the Commonwealth of Independent States.

A startement by Bank Hapoalim, Poalim Capital Markets' parent company, said PCM would "help Israeli exporters penetrate these markets and expand their international activity while providing credit to their customers and neutralising the risks involved".
A bank official said the company would begin offering services in the coming weeks.
Hapoalim said the company would draw on the experience of BB AVAL, the international financing arm of Berliner Bank. Hapoalim is BB AVAL's sole agent in Israel.
